info.name: Get the list of resource limits for a service.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the parent compartment (remember that the tenancy is simply the root compartment).

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The subscription OCID assigned to the tenant.

params.name: serviceName
params.description: The target service name.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional field, filter for a specific resource limit.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'. By default, it is ascending.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call.

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.

items.docs:
Includes a list of resource limits that are currently supported.
If the subscription ID is provided, then only resource limits supported by the subscription will be returned.
If the `areQuotasSupported` property is true, you can create quota policies on top of this limit at the compartment level.

info.name: Get the full list of resource limit values for the given service.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the parent compartment (remember that the tenancy is simply the root compartment).

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The subscription OCID assigned to the tenant.

params.name: externalLocation
params.description: The external cloud provider location.

params.name: serviceName
params.description: The target service name.

params.name: scopeType
params.description: Filter entries by scope type.

params.name: availabilityDomain
params.description: Filter entries by availability domain. This implies that only AD-specific values are returned.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional field, can be used to see a specific resource limit value.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. The sorting is by availabilityDomain, as a second level field, if available.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'. By default, it is ascending.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call.

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.

items.docs:
Includes a full list of resource limits belonging to a given service.
If the subscription ID is provided, the limit value for the subscription will be returned.

info.name: Returns the list of supported services that have resource limits exposed.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the parent compartment (remember that the tenancy is simply the root compartment).

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'. By default, it is ascending.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call.

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The subscription OCID assigned to the tenant.

items.docs:
Returns the list of supported services. If subscription ID is provided then only services supported by subscription will be returned.
This includes the programmatic service name, along with the friendly service name.

info.name: Get the availability and usage within a compartment for a given resource limit.

params.name: serviceName
params.description: The service name of the target quota.

params.name: limitName
params.description: The limit name for which to fetch the data.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment for which data is being fetched.

params.name: availabilityDomain
params.description:
This field is mandatory if the scopeType of the target resource limit is AD.
Otherwise, this field should be omitted.
If the above requirements are not met, the API returns a 400 - InvalidParameter response.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The subscription OCID assigned to the tenant.

params.name: externalLocation
params.description: The external cloud provider location.

items.docs:
For a given compartmentId, resource limit name, and scope, returns the following:
  * The number of available resources associated with the given limit.
  * The usage in the selected compartment for the given limit.
If the subscription ID is provided, then usage for resource created in that subscription will be returned.
Note that not all resource limits support this API. If the value is not available, the API returns a 404 response.
